description: Planet-in-house entries for venus (Vol II), paraphrased. Same row schema as data/planet_house.json; remedies carry optional structured action/item/venue/duration.

rows.theme: Swings between extremes: a benefic Venus gives a luxurious, comfortable life, a malefic one ruins it; spouse and mother are the pressure points.

conditions.effect: Venus here is read as an extreme planet: very good when benefic (comforts, vehicles, animals) and very bad when malefic. It also echoes Saturn's influence.
Strong urge for romance and indulgence, especially roughly ages 16 to 36; reckless behaviour can cost reputation, though the native's own health and luck hold up and the spouse's health suffers.
Marriage comes before steady earning and the spouse runs the household; long life and a large family.
Large progeny and long life.
Houses 7 and 10 empty (or holding only Rahu, Ketu, Saturn, Mercury) form the Fish Line: abundant wealth, but it needs a maid-servant or a cow in the home.
Sharp intellect and favourable court decisions; Moon is not usually harmful.
Venus with a malefic Saturn forms the Crow Line and is destructive; a marriage at 25 destroys wealth and spouse.
Malefic Venus can bring the mother death-like suffering, and the mother and wife do not get on; the Sun's matters stay unaffected.
Enemy planets in houses 1 and 7 bring a sickly spouse, family breakdown and possible divorce.
Troubles with relations, a licentious nature and many deaths around the native.
A malefic Jupiter, Sun and Saturn together, or Moon with Rahu and Sun in 1 and 7, give very poor health and bring other people's troubles to the native.

remedies.text: Restrain sexual escapades and heed the advice of elders.
If the spouse's family gave silver at the wedding, it offsets the Crow Line effects.
For the house-12 variant, donate barley, or seven mixed grains including mustard.
Donate a cow (for a woman chart) in charity.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted. Book text on exact remedy conditions is garbled.

rows.theme: Excellent family life and prosperity; the house of Venus's own comfort, wealth grows on its own.

conditions.effect: The native need not beg for favours, is a family man with growing wealth (every 8th year), good in-laws and public affection; no planet is debilitated in house 2.
Venus here gives twice the benefit; Saturn's results follow its house-9 reading. Prosperity for about 60 years, gains from animals and soft land.
Excellent luck; the house becomes like a palace.
Living in a house narrow at the front and broad at the rear (cow house) helps; Jupiter decides the fate of brothers and sons.
Living in a house broad at the front and narrow at the rear (lion house), dealing in gold, or an eclipse in the chart brings misery.
Children by a woman other than the spouse; with Rahu or Ketu in 2, 5, 9 or 12 the spouse is unfaithful and wealth is destroyed.
No procreation possible; ruin through widows or immoral partners.
Obstruction in marriage and children; the spouse may earn.
Book says that for a woman with Venus in 2 the husband is impotent, and for a man the wife is barren; low-confidence reading.

remedies.text: Take blood-building supplements with iron-based ingredients, under a doctor's advice.

rows.note: Book remedy mentions Mars items as medicine; kept only as a doctor-advised supplement.

rows.theme: Respect for the spouse brings luck; liked by women, wife is strong-willed.

conditions.effect: Favourite of women; the wife is bold and teasing but loyal, and her presence protects against theft, cheating and early death. Respecting her brings salvation and luck.
Mars conjoined or linked to Venus gives parental affection up to 15 and gain through the opposite sex under the spouse's control.
Pious spouse, no thefts, father's support.
Benefic Mercury gives a pilgrimage gain around age 20 and a share in parental property.
House 8 empty makes Venus lucky with victory over enemies, stronger than Sun or Jupiter here.
Poor health and troubles through disease; wealth up to about 34 but an unhappy life, progress after 34.
Mars or Mercury malefic, or enemy planets in 9 and 11, hurt wealth between 16 and 34, bring losses through brothers, relatives and daughters.

rows.note: No remedy given in the entry.

rows.theme: Illicit liaisons and love affairs; comforts but little marital bliss and few children.

conditions.effect: Frequent, enjoyable surface travel; comforts after 4 years of marriage; chances for flirtation, but the wife gives little comfort and children are few.
With no planet in 2 to 7 and Venus unlinked, two spouses are indicated (one older, one comforting) and children may still be few.
The shortage of children is made good.
Venus alone with 2 and 7 empty: any romance brings disrepute.
Intoxication causes destruction, via Mercury items.
Poverty (with divine help), conflict between wife and mother, harm to maternal uncle.
Covering a well, or building over one, brings childlessness; marriage at 22, 24, 25, 29, 32, 34, 45, 47, 51 or 60 is unfavourable.
If Venus and Moon are both malefic, the wife is inauspicious and daughters cause trouble; Jupiter decides the wife's condition unless linked to Saturn.

remedies.text: Establish the Moon (remedy of Moon), or throw Jupiter-ruled items into a well.
Keep a small pond or water vessel on the roof.
When Venus and Moon are both malefic, bury a black item in a peach stone outside the home.

rows.note: Remedy detail on the wife's health and Mars medicine omitted.

rows.theme: A family full of children; wealth follows character.

conditions.effect: Many children and a fortunate spouse; wealth via Venus articles. Religious conduct makes the native lucky, licentious conduct ruins him; wife and children stay content.
The native becomes a religious guide, wife is chaste and lucky, wealth and love of family grow.
Very lucky and wealthy.
Enemy planets with Venus here do not harm it.
Elder brothers, maternal uncles and in-laws become a source of loss.
House 12 destroyed also destroys Venus; losses through friends.
A love marriage here risks unfaithful children; Venus polluted by Saturn leads to immorality; Venus without aspect brings theft losses.

remedies.text: Serve a cow and keep conduct clean; loss of character means loss of wealth.
Use the Moon remedy to reduce malefic effects.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted.

rows.theme: Wealth depends on how one treats wealth; Venus here acts debilitated and harms companions and the partner more than the native.

conditions.effect: Pursuit of money and dominance over relatives; native good with words, health, speech and sight good; but loses by helping the poor and gets nothing from government service.
If the Moon is alive Venus gives no malefic results; comfortable old age, aided by the Moon remedy.
Comfortable life; results depend on Rahu or Ketu.
Very wealthy, but children may be spoiled; help from brothers, relations and father.
Ketu with Venus: hard work without gain, enemies; barrenness indicated in the book.
Loss of wealth; Jupiter, Sun and Moon all turn malefic.
Wasteful effort, damage to wisdom; Jupiter, Sun, Moon dormant or malefic.
A second son comes only after about 12 years.
Marrying an only child brings Mars-type harm; Mercury entering house 1 sets many things right.

remedies.text: Keep a solid silver bar or silver items at home.
Wife should wear a gold ornament on the head (and socks rather than barefoot) for children.
At marriage, give two gold pieces as a gift to the person with Venus in 6.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted.

rows.theme: Effects depend on the companion; very good when alone; long life and earning, philandering harms.

conditions.effect: Venus alone in 7 is extremely benefic; with a companion Venus gives that planet's results (Saturn the family, Ketu children, Rahu wealth, Mercury family life).

Long life (about 83 to 90), gains through travel but nothing from ancestral property; marriage at 25 gives a comfortable domestic life with a beautiful, non-interfering wife, provided no white cow is kept.
Wealth and a benefic Venus; business in comfort items does well.
Gains for about 37 years from marriage.
Venus alone here with Moon in 4: the native keeps away from sex, returns safely home and dies at home.
Venus with Jupiter, or a malefic Jupiter, causes business loss and childbirth difficulty.
Moon in 1 harms Venus; unlucky native.
Death of wives, especially with a skylight in the house.
Unlucky, troubled wife, who should avoid blue.
A troubled life, loss via the opposite sex.
Highly sexual, risk of disease; ill health of the spouse.

remedies.text: Be cool and kind-hearted; avoid partnerships with the wife's relatives.
Wife avoids blue colour.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted.

rows.theme: A woman made of burnt soil: protect the wife's health, worship and avoid gifts.

conditions.effect: The wife is harsh in temperament and her words take effect, so she should not be ignored; accept no gifts, stay content with own earnings and pray at a temple for victory over enemies.
If these are not alive Venus is benefic.
Licentious character and disease; do not stand surety for anyone.
In-laws, wealth and progeny destroyed; wife dominates; battlefield help but home front damage.
Unlucky till 11; better after 12; years 27, 34 and 39 to 45 are unlucky; do not marry before 25.

remedies.text: Donate barley or bury it in the ground to protect the wife's health.
Throw a copper coin or a flower into running drainage.
Serve or donate a cow; pray at temples.

rows.theme: A dark storm; self-earned wealth only, forefathers may be rich but not the native.

conditions.effect: Pilgrimages, intelligence and hard work; wealth only through toil; takes on other people's troubles.
Venus acts nine times beneficial if a mare, a well, silver or honey is kept at home or in the foundation.
From age 17 drinking and disease cause expense; wife diseased from marriage; spouse, children and wealth harmed.
Poverty and unfavourable children.
Obstruction in childbirth and poor business.
Blood disease.
Loss around age 25 via marriage, cow, farming or Venus relatives.

remedies.text: Bury a square or rectangular silver piece in a hole in a neem tree, closing it with neem wood.
Keep silver or honey at home or in the foundation for Venus to act nine times beneficial.
Wife wears red thread or red bangles.

rows.note: Book also suggests keeping a mare; omitted as an animal-keeping instruction.

rows.theme: An imaginary Saturn: benefic if Saturn is, with fondness for women and travel.

conditions.effect: Frequent chances for liaisons; fond of clothes, sex and travel; these turn Moon and Mars malefic.
With house 4 empty Venus acts like benefic Saturn; very sexy native of questionable character.
Saturn alone in 9 or 11 (exalted): gardens, orchards, wife's good health, comfortable old age while the western wall stays kachcha.
Moon alone here gives conveyance, wealth, comfort.
12 years of life trouble.
Eye troubles to the wife.
Malefic Saturn makes Venus unhappy; denied or dying children, a licentious wife; 12 years of suffering through children, brothers, wealth.

remedies.text: Donate a Kapila cow to save from Saturn's malefic effects.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted. Book's goat-keeping suggestion omitted.

rows.theme: Handsome, hankering after wealth; secretive, with a 20-year Venus period.

conditions.effect: A handsome, wealthy, comfortable native, otherwise weak virility; hankers after wealth from youth; secretive, changeable nature.
Strong unafflicted Mercury or Moon: wealth, secret acts, earns well for 12 years.
Wealth through birth of daughters.
Wealth stays but daughters cause losses; Mercury, Rahu, Ketu, Saturn give malefic results.
Benefit through Mars remedy or wife's brothers.
Three years after marriage everything may go wrong; sons die or are not born; the wife must not control the household finances.
Venus major period of 20 years is malefic.

remedies.text: Donate mustard oil.
Donate a Kapila cow.
Use Saturn-ruled or Moon-ruled items under medical advice for 40 to 43 days.

rows.note: Remedy text involving a private-body procedure, medicine or giving away a person was omitted.

rows.theme: A helpful deity in adversity; the wife rescues the native; comforts from the spouse for 37 years.

conditions.effect: Poor birth turns wealthy after marriage; royal favour, comfortable nights, the spouse brings luck; respect for the spouse brings domestic comfort.
Love of music and poetry; couple lives about 96 years.
Fish Line: the spouse has a troubled life, but the family and children are happy.
Houses 2 and 7 empty or afflicted give malefic Venus results.
Malefic Mercury: spouse a source of trouble, unlucky and unhappy.
Troubled life till 25.
Spouse suffers first and has poor health; strong Venus indicates early attraction to the opposite sex.

remedies.text: Donate a cow for the spouse's health.
Wife buries a blue flower in an open outdoor spot in the evening.

rows.note: Book's advice on which cow colour to keep omitted.
